title: Give your coin a voice, and a week of posts to go with it
blurb: Pick a character, tune its voice, get a week of X posts with matching cards.

parts.note: Cover image — goes in the cover slot at the very top, not in the body.

parts.html:
Your coin has a chart. Now give it a voice.

Mintmark turns one character into a full week of X posts, with a picture for every day.

Pick who's posting

A fox, a frog or a bot. Each one has a face and an attitude of its own. Rename it, add your ticker, and it's yours.

Tune how it talks

Three dials: humor, edge, signal. Add a brand line and the words it never says. Every post comes out in that one voice.

Get the whole week

Seven posts and seven matching cards, Monday to Sunday. Edit any line, then stamp the ones you ship. You post them yourself, so your account stays yours.

It's free to try, with no wallet and no sign-up.

One coin. One voice. Every day.

Mint your week on mintmark.world

Fox, frog or bot: which one should post for your coin?
